answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before joining the reef of services, like a diver posting collateral before entering a protected haven. The stake is slashed on proven misbehaviour, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs an attacker thousands of stakes, while honest agents earn the deposit back plus fees. An opal-like reputation token, earned only through verified work over time, further weights trusted agents, making cheap identity spam economically irrational.
